name: cto-powersuit
description: CTO Powersuit: agent skills for the work of a CTO, one plugin per function. Modules for decisions, docs and the deploy gate, plus the knowledge infrastructure plugins: an output filter you calibrate to yourself, a plain-Markdown vault with local search, and stance filters.

plugins.name: ai-ops
plugins.description: Operations for a team's coding agents: shared harness, spend per API request with a budget alert, an audit trail of tool calls with a denied-calls alert, coordinator pattern; gate check on agent settings.

plugins.name: aieo
plugins.description: AI search visibility: llms.txt, structured data, answer probes and hashed predictions, with a gate check on prediction hashes.

plugins.name: compliance
plugins.description: Control map to ISO 27001, TISAX, NIS2 and GDPR by number, AI Act triage and a website legal baseline, with gate checks for security.txt and third-party requests.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: RFCs, architecture decision records and a decision-log review, with templates and a gate check on ADR status, owner and date.

plugins.name: direction
plugins.description: Direction: a weekly review of the tracker across all areas (what moved, blocked, allocation, decisions needed) that records confirmed decisions, with a gate check on review memos.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Docs tree with owners and review dates, runbooks, a stale-page sweep, a static docs build and a gate check on review fields.

plugins.name: finops
plugins.description: Cost baseline, showback, unit costs, SaaS stack audit and FOCUS export, with a gate check that cost figures carry a period and a source.

plugins.name: fit
plugins.description: Estate assessment: runs the sdlc audit and recommends which modules to fit and in which order, with a gate check that fitted modules are installed. Repo clinic: audits a public repository at its owner's request and drafts one short report and one small pull request. File findings: a review's findings as GitHub Issues labelled by area, kind and severity, and a scorecard per area.

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Deploy gate: rules with pass and fail fixtures, run records, findings that close only on a passing rerun, and a workflow that deploys after the gate.

plugins.name: handover
plugins.description: Handover to the platform owner: training per module, exit criteria and a runs-without-me test plan, with a gate check on module owners.

plugins.name: hiring
plugins.description: Interview loop, anchored rubrics, evidence-first debriefs and a successor profile, with a gate check on rubric anchors.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Alloy, Prometheus, Loki, Grafana and Alertmanager via docker compose, dashboards as code and alert routes, with a gate check on alert rules.

plugins.name: red-team
plugins.description: Pressure tests for AI features: tactic plan, scripted multi-turn runs with a known right answer, grading on the decision; gate check on run records.

plugins.name: reliability
plugins.description: Availability targets, SLOs, incidents, postmortems, a static status page and on-call, with a gate check on the service catalogue.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Software delivery lifecycle: an audit for repositories built without one, the lifecycle map, tickets, review, test strategy and release, with a traceability gate check.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Supply chain, secrets and access for a repository and its agents: action-owner allowlist, vulnerability scan and SBOM, provenance checks for skills and MCP servers, key rotation, access review, threat models, and vulnerability intake, with gate checks for secrets and action owners, a pre-push hook for private terms, and a quarantine for third-party text.

plugins.name: vestige
plugins.description: Output filter you calibrate to yourself. Hooks scan every reply and every Markdown write.

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Plain-Markdown vault with hybrid local search as an MCP server, plus seed and atomize skills.

plugins.name: stance
plugins.description: Stance filters: professional-b2, good-chad, receipts, poles, mode-leak.
